method.elapsed_clock: cumulative CSV FrameTime, relative to capture start, not world/actor time
method.physics_interpretation: individual CPU scope durations; nested scopes and task-worker aggregates overlap and MUST NOT be summed as wall time
method.privacy: allowlisted footer fields only; command line, device/login IDs and event text omitted
method.late_scope_columns: use final header; earlier absent values are zero, matching UE writer semantics

selection.declared_rule: Complete positive-duration frames inside CSV-relative [10,20] seconds; no exclusions.

validation.count_scope: Actual end-of-run assertion; no independently sampled per-frame population claim.

execution_conditions.foreground_state: Not independently sampled; startup visibility is not a foreground guarantee.
execution_conditions.ambient_application_status: explicitly opted-in existing idle interactive Blender preserved

run_alignment.interpretation: Wall-log offset only; selection remains CSV-relative without invented world-time correction.

known_limitations: One existing legacy PNG at actor15 seconds remains in full and10-20-second timing; no screenshot spike was removed.
Full capture includes startup/spawn work. The predeclared CSV-relative10-20-second selection is the primary matched living-crowd comparison.
One repeat per count; capped results do not establish uncapped capacity or a causal explanation for every difference.
CSV profiler instrumentation adds overhead. C03 includes revised animation, navigation, collision and physics settings.

numeric_timeline.reproduction: Read this full numeric CSV and select capture_frame_index values in these inclusive ranges; preserve every selected value unchanged.
